title: Dynamic Pricing (Price Lists) — buyer-aware base prices
author: maarcingebala
body_preview: ## Summary  This issue presents a plan for adding **buyer-aware base pricing** to Saleor: the ability to charge a different list price for the same variant depending on *who* is buying (e.g. VIP clients, wholesale) and *when* they're buying (e.g. a time-limited window price). title: Drop support for HS256 JWTs
author: NyanKiyoshi
body_preview: Saleor currently supports JWT signing using HS256 which uses `SECRET_KEY`. This requires a sufficiently strong secret thus making HS256 security dependent on the entropy and the adequate protection of that secret.
